meta.dataset_name: 考研英语一完形填空闹钟题库
meta.description: 这是给 IronWill 闹钟模块使用的考研英语一完形填空题库。每条记录是一道单空选择题：题面只保留目标空为 ____，其他空已经按答案回填。
meta.included: 1986-2019 年考研英语一 Section I / 完形填空 / 英语知识运用，共 545 题。
meta.excluded: 1980-1985 题型和空号不稳定，暂不纳入；2020 目前只有答案解析 PDF，缺少对应真题题面 docx，暂不纳入。
meta.display_rule: 闹钟答题页显示 context_three_sentences、options、option_meanings_zh；详解解析已从开源版剥离（见 docs/DATA_SOURCES.md）
meta.opensource_note: review_explanation/explanation_source_file/answer_status/notes 已剥离；完整版数据请自备，勿再分发商业解析内容

passage.zh: ①周三下午，安妮乘公共汽车进城去市场购物。 ②在大约____个小时的时间里，她会在摊位之间走来走去，看看所有的东西，到处买，有时还敏锐地寻找便宜货。 ③然后，带着她需要买的所有东西，她会离开市场，来到镇上的街道上，以她最喜欢的方式再度过一个小时：看看家具店的橱窗。
passage.en: ①On Wednesday afternoons Annie took the bus into town to shop in the market. ②For an hour or ____ she would walk up and down between the stalls looking at everything, buying here and there, and keeping a sharp lookout for the bargains that were sometimes to be had. ③And then, with all the things she needed bought she would leave the market for the streets of the town to spend another hour in the way she liked best: looking in furniture shop windows.

They are always breaking away from the main caps and floating around, pushed by currents, until they eventually melt and are wasted. Many icebergs are, of course, far too small to be towed 6 distance, and would melt before they reached a country that needed them anywhere. It would be necessary to locate one that was 7 and that was big enough to provide a good supply of ice when it reached us. Engineers think that an iceberg up to seven miles long and one and a half miles wide could be transported if the tug pulling it was as big as a supertanker! Even then they would cover only twenty miles every day. However, 8 the iceberg was at its destination, more that 7,000 million cubic metres of water could be taken from it! That would probably be more than enough for any medium-sized city even in the hottest summer! But no doubt a use could be found for it. 9 , scientist say, there would not be too much wastage in such a journey. The larger the iceberg, the slower it melts, even if it is towed through the tropics. This is because when the sun has a bigger area to warm 10 , less heat actually gets into the iceberg. The vast frozen centre would be unaffected. [394 words]

passage.zh: 它们总是脱离主盖并在水流的推动下四处漂浮，直到最终融化并被浪费掉。当然，许多冰山太小，无法被拖曳____距离，并且在到达任何需要它们的国家之前就会融化。有必要找到一个易于管理且足够大的地方，以便在冰到达我们时能够提供充足的冰块。
passage.en: They are always breaking away from the main caps and floating around, pushed by currents, until they eventually melt and are wasted. Many icebergs are, of course, far too small to be towed ____ distance, and would melt before they reached a country that needed them anywhere. It would be necessary to locate one that was manageable and that was big enough to provide a good supply of ice when it reached us.

passage.en: Many icebergs are, of course, far too small to be towed any distance, and would melt before they reached a country that needed them anywhere. Engineers think that an iceberg up to seven miles long and one and a half miles wide could be transported if the tug pulling it was as big as a supertanker!

passage.zh: 为了大幅加强对媒体的法律控制，大法官欧文勋爵将提出一项法案草案，提议向证人支付非法费用，并严格控制审判开始前案件的宣传量。欧文勋爵在给下议院媒体特别委员会主席杰拉尔德·考夫曼的一封信中表示，他同意今年委员会的一份报告，该报告称自我监管并没有充分控制。这封信发表两天前，欧文勋爵表示欧洲立法中包含的隐私控制的解释将留给法官而不是议会，引起了媒体的强烈抗议。
passage.en: In a significant tightening of legal controls over the press, Lord Irvine, the Lord Chancellor, will introduce a draft bill that will propose making payments to witnesses illegal and will strictly control the amount of publicity that can be given to a case before a trial begins. In a letter to Gerald Kaufman, chairman of the House of Commons media select committee, Lord Irvine said he agreed with a committee report this year which said that self regulation did not ____ sufficient control. Publication of the letter came two days after Lord Irvine caused a storm of media protest when he said the interpretation of privacy controls contained in European legislation would be left to judges rather than to Parliament.
